prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a finished OPAQUE 2D mobile board-game environment background, vertical 2:3 canvas, target 1024 x 1536 pixels. Fill the entire canvas edge-to-edge with the world. No transparency, border, black bars or UI.
Primary request: newly illustrate a charming pastel low-poly/isometric park board-game scene. This is a new illustrated environment inspired by the general concept of a grassy park with a curving board path, NOT a screenshot collage, crop, UI mockup or copied interface.
Composition: a broad elevated three-quarter overhead isometric camera that clearly surveys a spacious park. The central subject is ONE continuous, coherent winding rounded board route made of large chunky pastel square tiles. The route curves from the lower foreground toward the middle-right, then gently loops/curves through the middle of the park. Make the curving board prominent and legible at mobile size, with pale yellow, powder blue, blush pink and lavender blank tiles, lightly beveled edges and warm sandy bases. No text or reward icons on the tiles.
Surroundings: fresh softly faceted green lawn, scattered low-poly green and pink-blossom trees, small shrubs and flower patches, a small blue pond with lily pads, flowers and two little white swans in the upper-middle/left park. Add several cute small buildings around the OUTSIDE of the board: a pastel cafe with awning, a tiny house, a friendly neighborhood shop, and a small creative studio building. They must be visibly recognizable as buildings, placed at the park perimeter/sides, at a sensible small board-world scale, framing the route WITHOUT covering or interrupting the board tiles. Narrow footpaths may connect them to the lawn. Maintain generous green breathing room.
Character: exactly ONE small lavender/purple board-game character token on a central tile, friendly simple geometric pawn/toy-like character, small relative to the world. No text bubble, label, badge or pointer over it.
Style: high quality polished pastel low-poly 2D game-background illustration with clean geometric forms, soft daylight, gentle grounded shadows, playful miniature diorama feel, restrained details, bright readable colors, broad scene. Fully rendered terrain reaches every edge. The board and token must remain the clear central subject; buildings sit around it.
Text: absolutely none. No lettering, numbers, names, watermarks or signs with words.
Must NOT include: any HUD, GO button, bottom menu, top bar, status indicators, coin/star UI, floating coin or star icons, counters, quantities, reward badges, buttons, sound/music buttons, gameplay overlays, banner, screenshot frame, phone bezel, black margin, cream UI panel, interface graphics, watermark, oversized buildings obscuring tiles, extra tokens. No real engine is required; output only this single opaque background artwork.
task: New opaque pastel low-poly isometric park board background with buildings around the board, replacing a blank region as a 2D artwork proposal only.

visualInspection.pond: two white swans, lily pads and flowers

scope: New background asset files and own metadata only; no source, design, STATUS or shared report changes.
limitsAndNext: New illustrated environment inspired by the concept; not an exact reproduction of source game geometry.
Static 2D background only; no board engine, tile hit targets or gameplay logic.
Real tool import, placement, HUD overlap and final visual approval are parent tasks.
Some perimeter buildings are naturally cut by the image edge; the central board route remains visible.
